name: Squabble House Worker — Male
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve black branded cap/apron, white shirt, yellow trousers, towel, black gloves/boots, metal spatula and full breakfast plate. Check spatula-hand continuity, clear incoming-versus-returning skillet, untouched meal and readable five-second timing.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact muscular adult brown-skinned cook with trimmed goatee, black cap and black apron carrying their existing yellow lettering, white collared short-sleeve shirt, yellow trousers, striped kitchen towel, black gloves and work boots. Keep the large steel spatula in his right hand and breakfast platter in his left. Existing garment wording is fixed costume detail; no new signs or labels.
0–0.7s: full-body action pose. A huge empty black iron skillet hurtles toward his breakfast platter like a spinning discus. He catches sight of it and turns his spatula flat, the metal face flashing a small sharp ivory glint. His left hand keeps the original waffle, eggs and bacon level.
0.7–2.5s: a dramatic close pass beside his right arm: the skillet hits the flat spatula with a violent PING, bending the utensil backward like a loaded spring. He twists through a powerful low-to-high pivot and releases that stored force. The SAME skillet rockets back the way it came, spinning so fast its rim draws a finite orange/ivory comet tail. Camera races alongside it and pulls back to reveal its source, a towering stack of three empty cast-iron pans. The returned skillet smashes through all three in a single escalating metallic cascade. No people struck, no room, stove or floor.
2.5–3.5s: the impact rebounds through the edit into a snap close-up of the cook. Exact title HANDS ON THE CLOCK slams in two clean lines below his face with the loudest iron CLANG. Apron and towel crack once in the shockwave. The breakfast platter is still in his left hand.
3.5–5s: complete proud pose against cyan. He uses the now slightly bent spatula to flip one waffle section exactly once and catches it back on the plate. He looks at the crooked spatula, straightens it with his thumb and gives the camera a flat workday stare. SFX: incoming skillet whistle, tense steel flex, dominant ricochet PING, accelerating metallic whirr, three crashing pan hits, title slam, small waffle pat and final spatula click. No speech or music.

name: Stoner Jr.
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve young adult face, short curls, olive hoodie, rainbow tie-dye, beige cargos, green sneakers, headphones and pendant. Cyan regions of tie-dye need keying review. Replace background green haze with bounded warm ivory/olive vapor, no scene wash. Review ice shatter, padlock release and headphone continuity.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact young ADULT brown-skinned man with loose short dark curls, small chin beard, hoop earring, oversized olive-green hoodie, rainbow tie-dye shirt, very baggy beige cargo trousers, green canvas sneakers, pendant and black headphones around his neck. Preserve the clothes and colors. His magic uses thick warm-ivory vapor ribbons shaded olive with black ink edges, never cyan/turquoise or full-background haze.
0–0.7s: complete loose-limbed slouch. He lazily clicks one headphone earcup. Ahead floats a huge black speaker cabinet, taller than him, trapped in a jagged pale-lavender ice shell with a massive padlock across its speaker cone. He rolls his neck once as one small vapor ring drifts from his sleeve.
0.7–2.5s: camera whips around that ring as it balloons into a colossal rotating smoke wheel with an OPEN cyan center. He kicks back and rides its lower inner curve like an impossibly laid-back skateboard ramp. The wheel barrels around the frozen speaker, wraps it in one continuous loop and tightens with a gigantic ivory/olive pressure pulse. Ice explodes outward in finite lavender shards and the padlock springs wide, flying away. The now-free speaker flexes once with a single enormous bass THUMP that blasts the broken ice into the distant cyan. Full physical payoff, no music playing.
2.5–3.5s: camera snap-zooms back as the same vapor wheel folds into a compact floating hammock under him. Exact title CHILL OUT slams below his relaxed face with that deep bass impact. Hoodie strings and curls bounce once, body remains anatomically clean.
3.5–5s: whole character reclining on the small vapor hammock, shoes and face fully in frame, restored speaker drifting beside him. One tiny ice chip approaches his sneaker; without looking he toe-flicks it far away, then closes one eye. Keep the hammock bounded, cyan visible above and below; no floor or scenery. SFX: headphone click, gathering air swirl, huge rushing wheel, ice CRACK and lock SNAP, one dominant low bass hit, title slam and tiny ice tick. No speech, music or smoking apparatus.

name: Stoner Sr.
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve older face, gray beard/locs, olive bucket hat/vest, muted tie-dye, brown wide trousers, beads, patterned sash and green sneakers. Wide source is reframed to portrait with whole-character establishment. Review ring relay continuity, no opaque smoke backing, no added fist emblems.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact older dark-skinned man with long gray-streaked locs, full white-gray beard, warm amused eyes, olive bucket hat and utility vest, muted cream/purple/green tie-dye shirt, wide brown trousers, patterned woven sash, wooden bead necklaces and bracelets, green sneakers. Preserve age, face and relaxed tai-chi stance. Vapor is warm ivory with olive shading and dark ink edges, with no turquoise light.
0–0.7s: establish his complete body in the wide low stance from the reference, fitted inside the portrait. He rolls one wrist slowly; a bead on his bracelet briefly lifts and three small open vapor rings form above his palm. Three enormous interlinked iron padlocks hang in a zigzag chain far ahead in empty cyan.
0.7–2.5s: he pivots smoothly through a full-body palm sweep. The front ring accelerates outward, growing to ten times his height; camera travels THROUGH its empty cyan center to reveal the spectacular depth. It slams around the first padlock, opens it with a thunderous snap, then divides into TWO rolling rings that pass the released momentum onward to the remaining two locks. Those two burst open in a staggered left-right relay, heavy metal links flying apart with huge bounded ivory/olive impact curls. The action is a clear pass-one-then-two sequence, never a full-screen fog sheet or random particles.
2.5–3.5s: the two rings orbit back around him and meet above his shoulders in a large open halo of flowing vapor. Exact title PASS IT AROUND slams below his face on the second enormous lock release. No additional emblems, fists or words.
3.5–5s: whole-character calm ending. The big rings shrink into three ordinary wooden beads and drop neatly onto the bracelet at his wrist. He pats them into place, tips his bucket hat and opens his free palm toward camera with a tiny knowing smile. The last loose lock link drops past; he casually nudges it aside with the back of his sneaker. SFX: soft bead rattle, deep gathering air rush, huge ring flyby, three escalating lock snaps and metal booms, title slam, airy return and delicate bead clicks. No speech, music or scenery.

name: STUD
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve muscular woman, short braided fade, face, earrings, silver chain, sleeveless blue denim vest, white tank, black cargo trousers and combat boots. Review two distinct figures during rescue, correct linked arms, shoulder contact, denim keying and full-body end.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact muscular adult brown-skinned woman with short neat braids over a sharp side fade, strong brows, stud earrings, silver chain necklace, sleeveless torn blue-denim vest, white tank top, baggy black cargo trousers with wallet chain and black platform combat boots. Preserve her strong shoulders and confident face; no makeover, no new power emblem.
0–0.7s: full-body guard pose beside a smaller faceless orange padded training mannequin. A gigantic black iron wrecking weight barrels directly toward the mannequin from deep cyan. STUD sees it coming and hooks her left arm securely around the mannequin's padded waist while winding her right shoulder forward.
0.7–2.5s: she steps ACROSS the incoming line and takes the entire weight with a thunderous right-shoulder check. The giant iron sphere visibly squashes at the contact for one exaggerated frame, a colossal bounded ivory/magenta impact star flares behind her, and her boots drive into a powerful sideways aerial skid. Camera pulls far back: she carries the protected mannequin twenty feet across empty space while using the shoulder impact to redirect the enormous weight into a dramatic upward arc. One decisive interception and escape, no blows to the mannequin, no floor or full-screen shockwave.
2.5–3.5s: with her free right hand she gives the redirected sphere one last full-body rising palm strike, sending it shrinking into distant cyan with a huge trailing crescent. Snap camera back as the exact title HOLD YOU DOWN slams beside her upper torso, face clear. Use an actual physical palm, no floating fist-shaped effect.
3.5–5s: whole-character ending. She sets the orange mannequin upright beside her, briefly checks its shoulder, then turns toward camera and brushes one small dust fleck from the denim vest with a cool half-smile. The mannequin wobbles once; without looking she steadies it with two fingers and holds her confident pose. SFX: incoming heavy rush, enormous shoulder THUD, boot scrape-like whoosh without a floor, rising launch CRACK, receding weight whistle, title impact and tiny padding squeak. No speech or music.
